name: Sampleo
tagline: FICTIONAL SAMPLE: AI notes for field sales teams

why_funded.point: A painful, daily problem for a clear buyer: reps lose hours typing notes after visits
Fast early traction: 400 paying teams within 9 months of launch

problem: Field sales reps spend about an hour a day writing up visits, so CRMs stay stale and managers fly blind.
solution: Reps talk after a visit; the app turns the voice note into a structured CRM update and next-step reminders.
who_its_for: Sales teams of 10-200 reps who visit customers in person (pharma, FMCG, building materials).

features.name: Voice-to-CRM update
features.what: Speak for 30 seconds; get a filled CRM record.
features.why_it_matters: Removes the task reps hate most, so adoption is high.
features.how_it_works: Speech-to-text, then an LLM extracts fields into a fixed schema, then a CRM API write.

features.name: Manager digest
features.what: A daily summary of every visit.
features.why_it_matters: Gives the buyer (the manager) a reason to pay.
features.how_it_works: Scheduled job summarises the day's structured records.

usp.detail: Records on device and syncs later, which general note apps do not do.
Supports 8 Indian languages with mixed-language speech.

business_model.revenue: Per-seat subscription, sold to the sales manager.

pricing.notes: SSO, audit logs, CRM custom fields

business_model.unit_economics_note: Not public. Gross margin depends on speech and LLM cost per minute; see the build plan for cost control.

position.value: Challenger in a growing niche, behind the large CRM vendors' built-in assistants

why_leading: Owns the offline, regional-language niche that big vendors ignore
Bottom-up adoption by reps, then a manager-led upgrade
market.differentiation_summary: Sampleo competes on offline use and regional languages; the big CRMs compete on distribution and bundling, and note apps compete on price.

competitors.name: BigCRM Assistant
competitors.what_they_do: AI assistant built into the largest CRM.
competitors.how_they_differentiate: Already installed for every customer of the CRM, so adoption costs nothing.
competitors.pricing: Bundled in the CRM's top plan
competitors.traction: Offered to millions of CRM seats (company statement)

competitors.name: GenericNotes
competitors.how_they_differentiate: Cheap and simple for any profession.

competitors.name: VoiceForms
competitors.what_they_do: Fills forms and CRM fields from speech for any industry.
competitors.how_they_differentiate: Fastest capture: results appear while the rep is still talking.

white_space.gap: Offline-first capture for rural field teams
white_space.evidence: Neither competitor supports it (their docs require a connection)

growth.detail: The first 50 customers came from personal outreach.

strengths: High rep adoption because it removes a chore

drawbacks.point: Depends on third-party speech and LLM prices
drawbacks.detail: A price rise or quality drop hits margin directly.

drawbacks.point: Large CRMs can copy the core feature
drawbacks.detail: Distribution advantage favours incumbents if they prioritise it.

tech.choice: React Native with local storage for offline
tech.note: Typical approach for offline-first field apps

opportunities.gap: Field teams in other trades (insurance agents, clinic reps)
opportunities.how_to_win: Same pipeline, different schema and language packs
